function.description: List all available MCP tools. Call this first to discover tool names before calling builtIn_mcpCallTool.
function.name: builtIn_mcpListTools

function.description: Call an MCP tool by name. Use builtIn_mcpListTools first to get available tool names.
function.name: builtIn_mcpCallTool

arguments.description: JSON object of tool arguments, e.g. {"query":"hello","limit":10}

function.description: Generate a random number between 0 and 1
function.name: builtIn_debugRandomNumber

function.description: Send a spark:command to one or more frontend-connected modules or sub-agents.
function.name: builtIn_emitSparkCommand

destinations.description: One or more target module or agent IDs for this command.

interrupt.description: Whether the command should preempt current work.

ack.description: Short acknowledgement or instruction summary for the receiver.

parentEventId.description: Optional parent event ID when this command is a response to another event.

traits.description: Trait name to adjust behavior. For example, "bravery", "cautiousness", "friendliness".

persona.description: Personas can be used to adjust the behavior of sub-agents. For example, when using as NPC in games, or player in Minecraft, the persona can help define the character's traits and decision-making style.

steps.description: Step-by-step actions the target should follow.

possibleOutcome.description: Expected outcomes if this option is followed.

fallback.description: Fallback steps if the main plan fails.

triggers.description: Conditions that should trigger this option.

options.description: Concrete execution options for the target.

guidance.description: Structured guidance for how the target should interpret and execute the command.

lane.description: Logical context lane, for example "game" or "memory".

ideas.description: Loose ideas to attach to the target context.

hints.description: Hints to attach to the target context.

strategy.description: How the target should merge this context update.

text.description: Primary text of the context update.

destinations.description: Optional routing for the attached context update.

metadata.description: JSON-like metadata for the context update, expressed as key-value pairs for schema compatibility.

contexts.description: Optional context updates to attach to the command.

function.description: Search the web for current or unfamiliar information and return a list of results with source URLs. Prefer what you already know; use this when the user asks or when the answer needs up-to-date facts.
function.name: web_search

query.description: The search query. Be specific; this is sent to a web search engine.

max_results.description: How many results to return (1-10), or null for the default of 5.

time_range.description: Restrict results to a recent time window when freshness matters, or null for no restriction.

include_domains.description: Only return results from these domains, or null.

exclude_domains.description: Never return results from these domains, or null.
